# Fillout Forms

Fillout is a platform that allows users to create and manage forms, offering a REST API for programmatic access to form data.

Category: Productivity. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/fillout-forms/.

## Actions

- **Authorize OAuth** (read-only): Initiate the oauth authorization process for third-party applications.
- **Get forms** (read-only): Retrieve a list of all forms in your account.
- **Invalidate Access Token**: Revoke an existing oauth access token.
